title: Mushroom pan with polenta
steps: Bring the stock to the boil, sprinkle in the polenta while stirring and let it thicken over low heat for 10–15 minutes, stirring often.
Slice the mushrooms and finely chop the onion and garlic.
Heat the oil in a pan until hot, fry the mushrooms for 5 minutes, add the onion, garlic and thyme and fry for 3 more minutes.
Stir the butter and half of the Parmesan into the polenta.
Spoon the polenta onto plates, top with the mushrooms and sprinkle with parsley, the remaining Parmesan and pepper.
